name_ar: تنفيذ خارطة الطريق تلقائياً: مرحلة لكل طلب دمج
name_en: Autonomous phase-per-PR roadmap execution loop
what: قيادة خارطة طريق معتمدة ذات مراحل حتى النهاية دون إشراف: وكيل منفذ معزول لكل مرحلة، وطلب دمج مشروط بنجاح CI والمراجع الآلي، ثم الدمج بعد مهلة وتحديث اللوحات وتسلسل المرحلة التالية. — Drive an approved phased roadmap to completion unattended with one isolated implementer subagent per phase, each PR gated on CI and the review bot, merged after a grace window, then dashboards updated and the next phase chained.
when: An approved roadmap with per-phase task files exists; 'run autopilot'; overnight multi-phase build; any unattended loop that needs finite limits and stop conditions.
how: 1) Preflight in every mode: gh installed and authenticated, git base branch reachable on origin, roadmap with progress dashboard plus per-phase task files, a config doc present, declared external tools up; refuse rather than invent plans. 2) init mode writes the config from the roadmap, then STOPS for human review. 3) run: orchestrator spawns one isolated implementer per phase, opens a PR, waits for CI and review bot via background wake-ups, fixes findings, merges only when the full merge gate holds after a grace window, updates dashboards, chains the next phase. 4) Declare finite loop limits and termination conditions up front; stop on any unmet precondition.
params: mode (init|run|status); roadmap path; grace window; loop limits; retry-watchdog env for unattended sessions
